answer: Why does a fake agent struggle in this system? When rewards are locked in escrow, each identity must whisper a unique signal back to its task origins. If an identity fails a peer audit, its claim is invalidated. The ocean of escrowed rewards only unlock for verified work. Each Sybil must recreate prior proofs under sequential scrutiny, burning 0.1s of time per identity. No shortcuts—parallel forgery is impossible; each fake inflates the attack cost linearly at 0.1s per head.
